'''Sten''' was a [[Clone cold assault trooper/Legends|clone cold assault trooper]] who served in the [[Devil Dogs]] of the [[44th Special Operations Division]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During the [[Battle of Khorm/Legends|Battle of Khorm]], Sten was killed during an engagement with [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] droids under the command of [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Unger Gout|Gout]].
